name: prismeai-office-addin
description: Chat with a Prisme.ai agent that always knows the document you have open (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook).

scripts.validate: npx --yes office-addin-manifest validate dist/manifest.xml && npx --yes office-addin-manifest validate dist/manifest-outlook.xml
scripts.package: mkdir -p dist && rm -f "dist/prismeai-office-addin-$npm_package_version.zip" && zip -r -X "dist/prismeai-office-addin-$npm_package_version.zip" taskpane.html taskpane.js icons vendor -x '*.DS_Store' '*.svg'
